nodes.label: Himan Personal Productivity Suite
nodes.rationale: Single monorepo hosting notes, passwords, file storage, credit cards, invoice generator, grocery lists and subscriptions so platform-specific apps can share one domain layer instead of duplicating business logic per platform.

nodes.label: npm Workspaces Monorepo Layout
nodes.rationale: workspaces = packages/*, web, mobile. Install must always run from root so workspace symlinks resolve; per-package installs break the shared package link.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Clean Architecture (domain/infrastructure/presentation)
nodes.rationale: Domain holds pure business logic with no framework imports; infrastructure imports domain only; presentation is platform-specific. Domain + infrastructure live in packages/shared so web and mobile reuse them; each platform re-exports via its own infrastructure/index.ts so internal path aliases never change.

nodes.label: Module Boundary Rule (index.ts public API)
nodes.rationale: Inter-module imports must go through index.ts and never internal paths, so each module stays independently deletable.

nodes.label: @himan/shared Package (raw .ts subpath exports)
nodes.rationale: Exports raw .ts with no build step, consumed directly by Vite and Metro. tsconfig omits the DOM lib so browser-specific code fails at compile time; browser-only services (ThumbnailService, CompressionService, InvoicePDFService, LocalNotesStorage) therefore stay in web.

nodes.label: Supabase init/get Singleton Dependency Injection
nodes.rationale: Each platform calls initSupabase once at startup with its own env vars and auth storage; every repository calls getSupabase(). Keeps the shared package free of platform env assumptions. Same init/get pattern applies to Logger.

nodes.label: Web Path Alias @core Gotcha
nodes.rationale: The directory is src/modules/shared but the alias is named @core, not @shared — a naming mismatch that must be replicated in vite.config.ts, tsconfig.app.json and vitest.config.ts. Mobile deliberately uses only @/* -> ./src/*.

nodes.label: Row-Level Security via auth.uid()
nodes.rationale: RLS is enabled on every table and every policy is scoped through auth.uid(), so data isolation is enforced at the database rather than in client code.

nodes.label: Adding a New Module Recipe
nodes.rationale: Four-step recipe: shared domain+infrastructure, package.json subpath export, web presentation + alias registration in three config files, mobile presentation + alias in tsconfig and Metro.
